chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 1 — Secondary Source (3 points) — Set 2
chunks.content: AP European History SAQ 1 (Secondary Source), 3 points, one per part. Set 2 prompts: A [1] describe the main argument the historian makes in the excerpt; B [1] describe a relevant historical context for the development discussed; C [1] explain one way the development discussed affected European society/politics. 'Describe' = relevant characteristics; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: A restating a detail rather than the overall argument; B naming a context without connecting it to the development; C describing an effect without the causal how.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 1 (Set 2) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Stated the historian's argument, gave a relevant historical context, and explained an effect of the development. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 1 (Set 2) scored 2/3 (A 1, B 0, C 1). Stated the historian's argument (A) and explained an effect (C) but did not give a valid historical context (B). Illustrates missing the contextualization part while handling argument and effect.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 1 (Set 2) scored 1/3 (A 0, B 0, C 1). Earned only C (explained an effect of the development). Lost A (did not correctly state the historian's argument) and B (no valid context). Illustrates a response that explains an effect but misreads the source's argument.
